answer: The lotus register is checked at draw time, haven lists the eligible set, and lantern seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 79 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 79 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 32 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
